name: mavenImport
description: Reads a pom.xml file and downloads each listed dependency into Lucee's local Maven cache. Returns a query of what was resolved.

params.name: pomPath
params.description: The path to the pom.xml file.

params.name: includeTransitive
params.description: When true, also resolves the dependencies of each dependency.

params.name: includeOptional
params.description: When true, also resolves optional dependencies. Only used when `includeTransitive` is true.
